issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a whole ticket pack, win... a tractor rack!
issues.justification: The source rhyme refers to a water pump tower (водокачка), a absurd prize; 'tractor rack' is an invented, meaningless prize and the lottery-ticket gag is weakened.

issues.source_quote: за чужой счёт пьют даже трезвенники и язвенники
issues.translation_quote: On someone else's dime, even teetotalers and convalescers drink!
issues.justification: 'язвенники' means people with ulcers, not 'convalescers'; mistranslation that destroys the joke.

issues.source_quote: если человек идиот - то это надолго
issues.translation_quote: 'If a man is an idiot, it's for a long time!'
issues.justification: The boss's aphorism is rendered awkwardly and literally; the punchy wording ('being an idiot is for life') is lost. Also the 'наш любимый шеф' catchphrase format varies throughout.

issues.source_quote: Ну что Вы, время! Время - деньги!
issues.translation_quote: Come on, time! Time is money!
issues.justification: Flat and unnatural dialogue, slightly detached from context.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: May you drop dead! May I see you in a coffin, in white slippers! May you live... on nothing but... your salary!
issues.justification: The neighbour's Odessa/Yiddish-flavoured speech (исдох, у гробу, у белых тапках) is lost; the translation is neutral and the curse's punchline is padded with hesitation dots.

issues.source_quote: Это - я, я, я! ... Шикарный план, шеф!
issues.translation_quote: A brilliant plan, boss! By 12:00 everything will be ready!
issues.justification: Fine, but 'Хаза? Ксива?' criminal slang rendered 'Crib? Papers?' mixes American and neutral; 'Печёнкой чую' rendered 'in my gut' ok. Main loss: 'Ты меня уважаешь? ... Тогда я тебя укушу!' drunk humor rendered okay. Criminal-slang register is inconsistent across the translation.
